scenicChapters.title: Garden Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 142 km this is Garden Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Seven Passes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 380 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

south-africa-garden-route-high-and-coast.story: From George it runs 522 km to Knysna; allow about 10 h of riding. It is a high-mountain day.
